dedupe_keys.name: ilhabela 2 m terrain model and land surface parameters

description: The Ilhabela research team publishes a two-metre bare-earth digital terrain model and terrain-derived layers for the island municipality off São Paulo state, Brazil. It is a separate Zenodo package and DOI from the neighbouring São Sebastião product. The article says the two products were generated from 2023–2024 airborne lidar, with ground-point classification, triangulated interpolation and smoothing. Seventeen land-surface parameters and objects include slope, aspect, curvature and hydrological terrain measures. The original lidar point clouds cannot be shared under the supplier agreement, but the processed raster data are free to access under CC BY 4.0 and the article describes compressed TIFF outputs. This topography can inform steep-slope failure, drainage and road-access simulations for settlements and critical facilities on Ilhabela. It does not include traffic, assets or a calibrated landslide model. The two-metre elevation surface can miss small culverts and channels, and the article's comparison to older map heights shows systematic differences in forested terrain. The dataset complements data-ahn-netherlands-elevation-model as a local terrain input in another country. No raster was downloaded.
